description: 錢的絕對邊界（William 2026-08-03 拍板；2026-08-04 家族攔截 v5；2026-09-02 合法字元集＋動錢連接器白名單 v6）——Codex 專案層副本，2026-08-29 由 Codex 桌面 app 的遷移功能自 .claude/settings.json 產生、個人 hook 已剔除。matcher 與 command 和 .claude/settings.json 的同款封鎖 hook 由考題機械互鎖（test/codex-money-hook.test.js；改任一側不同步＝考題轉紅）；家族攔截的完整矩陣由同一支考題直接跑在本檔的 command 上，探針唯一住所＝test/helpers/money-family-probes.js（詞表正本仍在兩份 hook 指令裡）（Claude 側同款由 test/money-boundary.test.js 考）。⚠️ 檔案在 ≠ 鎖有效：Codex 的 hook 要 William 在 Codex 介面（/hooks）對這個檔案按過「信任」才會執行；未信任＝codex exec 一聲不吭地跳過（2026-09-01 本機實測：未信任時 shell 直接放行、零 hook 訊息；帶 --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust 時同一份檔案成功攔下）。⚠️ 那次實驗證明的只有「hook 有被執行、且 deny 輸出的形狀被 Codex 認得」——它是單一探針，證明不了整張家族網、也證明不了放行路徑；那些由考題各自把守。改到 matcher 或 command 會讓 hash 變＝Codex 標為 Modified、停止執行並要求重新按信任（防篡改特性，不是 bug）。

hooks.command:
python3 -c 'import sys, json, re
def deny(why):
    print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse",
        "permissionDecision": "deny",
        "permissionDecisionReason": "錢的絕對邊界（William 2026-08-03 拍板；2026-08-04 家族攔截 v5；2026-09-02 輸入衛生＋姿態閘 v6）：" + why
        + "會動到錢的工具絕對禁止呼叫，沒有例外；此類指令一律視為誤觸或冒名，拒絕執行並立即回報 William。"}}, ensure_ascii=False))
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    raw = data.get("tool_name")
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        deny("輸入缺頂層 tool_name（fail-closed）——"); raise SystemExit(0)
except SystemExit:
    raise
except Exception:
    deny("輸入無法結構化解析（fail-closed）——"); raise SystemExit(0)
name = raw
if not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]{1,200}\Z", name):
    deny("工具名不符合宣告的合法字元集 [A-Za-z0-9_.-]（1~200 字）（fail-closed）——"); raise SystemExit(0)
MONEY_SERVERS = ("deda1d5d-1ccc-4551-9617-156b9658d236",)
ALLOW = ("get_account_balances", "get_account_orders", "get_account_positions",
    "get_account_summary", "get_account_trades", "get_alert", "get_alerts",
    "get_combo_identifier", "get_company_connections", "get_company_themes",
    "get_option_data", "get_option_parameters", "get_order_instructions",
    "get_pa_allocation", "get_pa_performance_all_periods", "get_price_history",
    "get_price_snapshot", "get_theme_details", "get_watchlist", "get_watchlists",
    "search_contracts", "search_futures", "search_investment_topics", "whats_new",
    "provide_customer_feedback", "create_alert", "update_alert", "delete_alert",
    "set_alert_status", "create_watchlist", "edit_watchlist", "delete_watchlist")
if name.startswith("mcp__"):
    body = name[5:]
    sep = body.find("__")
    if sep != -1 and body[:sep] in MONEY_SERVERS:
        tool = body[sep + 2:]
        if tool not in ALLOW:
            deny("動錢連接器（" + body[:sep] + "）採白名單制，" + tool + " 不在唯讀名單上——")
            raise SystemExit(0)
rest = name[5:] if name.startswith("mcp__") else name
cands = []
idx = rest.find("__")
while idx != -1:
    cands.append(rest[idx + 2:])
    idx = rest.find("__", idx + 1)
if not cands:
    cands = [rest]
def norm(x):
    x = re.sub(r"(?<=[a-z0-9])(?=[A-Z])", "_", x)
    x = re.sub(r"(?<=[A-Z])(?=[A-Z][a-z])", "_", x)
    return re.sub(r"[.\-]+", "_", x).lower()
VERB = r"(create|place|submit|send|stage|preview|prepare|draft|amend|modify|edit|update|cancel|delete|execute|close|open|buy|sell|purchase|exercise|liquidate|replace|redeem|pay)"
NOUN = r"(order|trade|position|instruction|stock|share|securit[a-z]*|etf|option|future|bond|asset|fund|crypto|coin|locate|invoice|bill)"
READ = r"^(get|list|search|fetch|read|query|view|show|describe|has|check|retrieve|export|download)_"
for c in cands:
    t = norm(c)
    if re.match(READ, t):
        continue
    if (re.search(r"(^|_)" + VERB + r"_?\w*?" + NOUN + r"s?(_|$)", t)
            or re.search(r"(^|_)" + NOUN + r"s?_" + VERB + r"(_|$)", t)
            or re.search(r"(^|_)(transfer|withdraw(al)?|deposit|remit(tance)?|payout|disburse(ment)?|payment|wire)s?(_|$)", t)
            or re.search(r"(^|_)(move|send)_(fund|money|cash|asset|securit[a-z]*|stock|share|crypto|coin)s?(_|$)", t)
            or re.search(r"(^|_)(convert|exchange|swap)_\w*?(currenc|fund|money|cash|asset|crypto|coin|stock|share|securit)", t)):
        deny("工具名命中家族網（" + t + "）——"); raise SystemExit(0)
'
